neighbours.label: fixed slogans built by repeating a word or frame ('first-come, first-served', 'buy one get one', 'pay as you go', 'use it or lose it', 'first in, first out')
fire: Parking is offered on a first-come, first-served basis.
The store has a buy one get one sale on shoes.
The gym has a pay as you go membership.
Vacation days follow a use it or lose it policy.
Layoffs go by last in, first out at the plant.
Seats at the clinic are first come, first served.
Her coach always said no pain, no gain to the team.
These pizzas are buy one get one half price tonight.
quiet: Parking is offered on a two-hour, paid basis.
The store has a big summer sale on shoes.
The gym has a yearly family membership.
Vacation days follow a strict company policy.
Layoffs go by department at the plant.
Seats at the clinic are soft and blue.
Her coach always said good morning to the team.
These pizzas are large and quite cheap tonight.

notes: Card: ' come' x2, ' as' x2, 'one' x2, 'ome', ' One', ' in', ' it'. Probe: ' one' 1.036; 'ome' of first-come 0.920; ' it' 0.659; ' as' 0.575; ' out' 0.372; the plain frames 0.015-0.049. The test repeats these slogans in new frames plus two new ones: 'last in, first out' and 'no pain, no gain'.
